metadata.scope: White labeling: the AngularJS admin and Admin Shell blades, the REST contract, xAPI resolution and the storefront rendering and Company logo. Excludes vc-shell auth-page branding, Site Builder palette interplay, ImageTools thumbnail internals, custom-domain activation mechanics (domain map 'excludes').
